Ava (Docs): Heads up — Product wants a short migration playbook for v1->v2 (invoke/generate). Need one-pager + 3 snippets (cURL, JS shim, Python) by Thu.

Jon (API Eng): Key diffs: `model_id` -> `model`, `input` -> `messages` array, streaming event renamed `token` -> `delta`. We added `X-Compat-Mode: v1` header for temporary opt-in.

Ava (Docs): Can you paste minimal before/after cURL and a note about redirects?

Jon (API Eng): Old:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/invoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model_id":"rwd-small","input":"Hello"}'
```
New:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-small-2","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
```
Note: POSTs without compat header will get 410 after Stage 3; GETs get 307 during Stage 2.

Priya (Security): Add privacy line: compat header may appear in logs up to 30d.

Marco (Support): I'll add two canned replies and an escalation checklist.

Ava (Docs): Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2891 — please review API wording and snippets.

DeployBot: deploy queued for docs-staging at 1732106000.

Ava (Docs): Thanks all — aim to ship Friday after signoffs.
